; BLM LC5 set KERFX1 — 4 subprogram file(s)
; ==== KERFX1.SPF
;ADILAS
;STEEL,1000,500,3
;IDMAT=0010
;NOMEMAT=STEEL
;ALIASMAT=STEEL
;IDGAS=1
;NOMEGAS=Nitrogen
;Postprocessor version 2.0.0
;R220=Z16*1000+2*100+0
R12=3
R201=0.0    ;lunghezza barretta utensile 1
R202=0.0    ;lunghezza barretta utensile 2
R203=0.0    ;lunghezza barretta utensile 3
R21=1000
R22=500
R23=287.5
R24=237.5
R523=37.5
R524=37.5
R500=0
INITNEST
ORIG(50,50,0)
N1 CALL"/_n_wks_dir/_n_sheet_wpd/_n_KERFX701_spf"
ORIG(400,50,0)
N2 CALL"/_n_wks_dir/_n_sheet_wpd/_n_KERFX702_spf"
ENDNEST
RET

; ==== KERFX701.SPF
;M01
R16=chk_pret
CICLA:
INITPART(1)
;DEMO-001
NEXT_L(200.,40.,0,0,9)
PROFILE
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,200.,40.,260.,40.,0,0)
NEXT_L(-7.,-12.5,1,2,3)
G01 X0. Y-12.5
PROFILE
G01 X300. Y-12.5
G03 X312.5 Y0. I0. J12.5
G01 X312.5 Y200.
G03 X300. Y212.5 I-12.5 J0.
G01 X0. Y212.5
G03 X-12.5 Y200. I0. J-12.5
G01 X-12.5 Y0.
G03 X-2.171 Y-12.31 I12.5 J0.
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,-2.171,-12.31,0.,-12.5,0,0)
ENDGEO
IF R16==1
	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
ENDPART
RET

; ==== KERFX702.SPF
;M01
R16=chk_pret
CICLA:
INITPART(1)
;DEMO-001
NEXT_L(100.,160.,0,0,9)
PROFILE
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,100.,160.,40.,160.,0,0)
NEXT_L(-7.,-12.5,1,2,3)
G01 X0. Y-12.5
PROFILE
G01 X300. Y-12.5
G03 X312.5 Y0. I0. J12.5
G01 X312.5 Y200.
G03 X300. Y212.5 I-12.5 J0.
G01 X0. Y212.5
G03 X-12.5 Y200. I0. J-12.5
G01 X-12.5 Y0.
G03 X-2.171 Y-12.31 I12.5 J0.
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,-2.171,-12.31,0.,-12.5,0,0)
ENDGEO
IF R16==1
	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
ENDPART
RET

; ==== KERFX1LIS.SPF
KERFX1.SPF
KERFX701.SPF
KERFX702.SPF
